brief: Formal, symmetrical two-storey stone farmhouse, five bays wide, of squared buff and grey limestone in regular courses with dressed sills and lintels, under a low hipped roof of silver standing-seam metal with a plain boxed cornice. A small white entry portico on slender posts with a scroll-sawn frieze carries a white-railed balcony reached by a second-floor door; black louvered shutters on the ground-floor six-over-six windows, black iron star anchors. A round bed of daylilies and a clipped shrub in a flagstone circle in front, big shade trees at the sides.
